Five files import `convertToSmallestCurrencyUnit` from `@calcom/lib/currencyConversions` (the `packages/lib/currencyConversions.ts` definition) and call it:

- `packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/PaymentService.ts` (line 160)
- `packages/app-store/hitpay/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx` (line 88)
- `packages/app-store/paypal/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx` (line 80)
- `packages/app-store/stripepayment/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx` (line 109)
- `packages/features/bookings/lib/handlePayment.ts` (line 161)

The other files that matched the name don't use that function:

- **Separate copies:** `packages/app-store/btcpayserver/lib/currencyOptions.ts` and `packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/currencyConversions.ts` each define their own function with the same name. The BTCPay Server settings component calls its own local copy, not the `packages/lib` one. I did not find any importer of the hitpay copy.
- **Comment-only mentions:** `packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/PaymentService.test.ts` and `packages/app-store/paypal/lib/Paypal.test.ts` mention the function only in comments. Neither test imports or calls it, so no test file uses it directly.
